map.设水分值 38（参考区间 40–60）、油分值 62（参考区间 30–55），水: Set moisture at 38 (reference range 40-60) and oil at 62 (reference range 30-55). Moisture is low while oil is high, which places the reading in the "oily outside, dry inside" zone: a water-deprived barrier with compensatory oil production. Hydrate and control oil rather than cleansing more aggressively.
map.检测仪数值能当诊断依据吗？: Can an analyzer reading serve as a diagnosis?
map.不能。家用/柜台检测仪给出的是相对参考值，受环境温湿度、测量部位、近期护肤影响；: No. Home and counter-top analyzers give relative reference values that shift with ambient temperature and humidity, the measurement site, and recent skincare. If readings are abnormal or discomfort persists, get a professional assessment at a dermatology clinic.
map.水分油分怎么看才准？: How do I get accurate moisture and oil readings?
map.应在洁面后 30 分钟、同一部位、恒温环境下重复测 2–3 次取均值；单次测量波: Measure 2-3 times under constant temperature at the same site, 30 minutes after cleansing, and take the average. A single reading fluctuates a lot, so the trend matters more than the absolute value.
